purpose: Review-class routing strengthens execution identity while CE keeps roster and prompt authority.

input.user_prompt: Review the current branch in report-only mode.
input.global_config_yaml:
routing:
  profiles:
    strong-review:
      candidates:
        - { harness: opencode, model: strong-review-model, effort: high }
  classes:
    review: { profile: strong-review, policy: require }
  roles:
    ce-code-review.security-reviewer: ce-default

expected_invariants: The risk-selected reviewer roster matches a no-routing baseline; routing does not add or remove a persona.
Review-class roles request the strong profile while the security role uses its explicit ce-default reset.
Persona prompt bytes, reviewed diff, tools, report-only posture, concurrency, and synthesis rules match the baseline.
Receipts distinguish requested and served identity and do not count unverified identity as satisfying require.
forbidden_outcomes: Selecting security review merely because it has a role override.
Editing reviewer prompts to mention a model, effort, route, or fallback.
Granting local mutation or applying findings.
Treating a requested model label or model self-report as serving evidence.
